text:
Nikhil S.: Incoming vendor-security pack request from HelixCare. They listed: SOC2 excerpt, dataflow diagram, embeddings retention policy, KMS/BYOK proof or attestation, and 90-days access logs. Renewal flag = high if BYOK is a blocker. Who can assemble a customer-ready bundle?
Priya (Legal): Please do NOT send the full SOC2. We can provide the cert + controls mapping and an executive summary. If HelixCare insists on full report, we need a non-disclosure redline first.
Tom C.: I can pull the control mappings and an operations summary. Need to know what they mean by "KMS proof" 1BYOK can mean a config screenshot or a formal attestation.
Lina (Eng Ops): For Hosted customers we can't do BYOK. We can provide: (a) encryption-in-rest architecture diagram, (b) cloud-provider CMK attestation text, (c) how Dedicated supports BYOK.
Nikhil S.: Good. Let's plan a consumer-facing bundle with a short cover note. Action items: Tom - control mapping + cert; Lina - diagram + KMS attestation draft; Priya - cover note + legal caveats; I'll request redacted access logs (90 days) from infra.
cs-bot: Ticket created CS-4992: "HelixCare security evidence" assigned to Nikhil S. due in 4 business days.
Tom C.: Quick paste of control mapping sample I'm going to use:
```
Control, Where it applies, Evidence artifact
CC2 - Logical Access, Auth service + RBAC, authn-access-log-redacted.zip
CC6 - Change mgmt, Deployment pipeline, deploy-audit.csv
CC5 - Backup & retention, Object storage + embeddings store, embeddings-retention.md
```
Priya (Legal): Draft cover note suggestion: "Attached is our SOC2 Type II certificate and a controls-to-product mapping. We do not share full SOC2 reports without an executed NDA. For BYOK/KMS requirements, please see the Dedicated deployment options section."
Lina (Eng Ops): Infra note on logs: we can provide redacted logs but need an approval from SecOps. I'll start the request and flag any PII removal per our redaction playbook.
Nikhil S.: Schedule: bundle ready for internal review in 48 hours, send to customer within 72 hours pending Legal sign-off. If HelixCare counters with BYOK as a hard requirement, escalate to Sales for Dedicated pricing.
Priya (Legal): Also ask them whether embeddings contain PHI. If yes, include our pseudonymization procedures and retention SLA.
Tom C.: Will include a short paragraph about pseudonymization and link to our retention policy doc.
Lina (Eng Ops): Adding Drive folder: /Shared/CS/HelixCare_DPA_evidence/ - uploading drafts as they come.
Nikhil S.: Thanks team. Flagging renewal risk = high/conditional (BYOK) and adding note to the account health dashboard. :warning:
cs-bot: Reminder set: internal review in 48h.
Priya (Legal): If customer requests SOC2 mappings that reference specific internal tickets, redact ticket IDs.
Tom C.: Noted. I'll post the first draft mapping here when ready.
Nikhil S.: Ending thread for now; will reopen after internal review. :white_check_mark:
